plugins.name: NEXUS Library
plugins.description: Private account-scoped file library backed by NEXUS attachments and chat history.

plugins.name: Google Drive
plugins.description: Import files and context from Google Drive.
plugins.reason: Requires a server-side OAuth callback, encrypted token storage and account-scoped permission checks before activation.

plugins.name: Dropbox
plugins.description: Import files and context from Dropbox.
plugins.reason: Requires a server-side OAuth callback, encrypted token storage and account-scoped permission checks before activation.

plugins.name: GitHub
plugins.description: Read repositories and let NEXUS work with authorized project content.
plugins.reason: Requires a server-side GitHub App/OAuth bridge with scoped repository permissions before activation.

plugins.name: MCP / OpenAPI connectors
plugins.description: Generic connector layer for future tools without putting credentials in browser JavaScript.
plugins.reason: Requires a NEXUS server-side connector registry, secret vault and execution policy.
